cases.transcript: The current identifier is OH-RIVER-17.
cases.rationale: The speaker directly and unconditionally endorses the registered current value.

cases.transcript: Confirmed: OH-RIVER-17 is current.
cases.rationale: The speaker explicitly confirms the registered current value.

cases.transcript: The earlier value was OH-RIVER-19. Correction: the current identifier is OH-RIVER-17.
cases.rationale: An explicit later correction unambiguously selects the registered value.

cases.transcript: OH-RIVER-17 is not wrong.
cases.rationale: The local double-negative predicate affirms rather than rejects the value.

cases.transcript: There is no doubt that OH-RIVER-17 is current.
cases.rationale: No doubt is an unambiguous affirmation, not uncertainty.

cases.transcript: No, after checking, the current identifier is OH-RIVER-17.
cases.rationale: No rejects prior context while the following clause affirms the registered value.

cases.transcript: OH-RIVER-17 does not appear to be current.
cases.rationale: The postpositive negation denies that the registered value is current.

cases.transcript: OH-RIVER-17 cannot be the current identifier.
cases.rationale: Cannot be explicitly rules out the registered value.

cases.transcript: OH-RIVER-17 should not be treated as current.
cases.rationale: The speaker instructs the listener not to treat the value as current.

cases.transcript: OH-RIVER-17 was never confirmed.
cases.rationale: Never confirmed cannot earn current-fact credit.

cases.transcript: OH-RIVER-17 is by no means current.
cases.rationale: By no means is an explicit denial.

cases.transcript: OH-RIVER-17 is anything but current.
cases.rationale: Anything but current excludes the registered value.

cases.transcript: OH-RIVER-17 is unlikely to be current.
cases.rationale: An unlikely value is not an affirmed current fact.

cases.transcript: OH-RIVER-17 is hardly current.
cases.rationale: Hardly current rejects a confident current-fact interpretation.

cases.transcript: I deny that the identifier is OH-RIVER-17.
cases.rationale: The speaker explicitly denies the proposition containing the registered value.

cases.transcript: I dispute that the identifier is OH-RIVER-17.
cases.rationale: A disputed proposition is not an endorsed current fact.

cases.transcript: I reject OH-RIVER-17 as the identifier.
cases.rationale: The registered value is the object of explicit rejection.

cases.transcript: I decline to confirm OH-RIVER-17.
cases.rationale: Declining confirmation cannot earn confirmed-memory credit.

cases.transcript: The caller merely said, "The identifier is OH-RIVER-17."
cases.rationale: A report of the caller's words does not endorse the value as current.

cases.transcript: The caller mentioned OH-RIVER-17.
cases.rationale: Mentioning what the caller said is not current-fact acknowledgement.

cases.transcript: The caller repeated OH-RIVER-17.
cases.rationale: Reported repetition is not speaker endorsement.

cases.transcript: The user uttered OH-RIVER-17.
cases.rationale: Attributing a token to the user is not an affirmative readback.

cases.transcript: The user told me OH-RIVER-17.
cases.rationale: The sentence reports provenance without asserting current truth.

cases.transcript: According to the user, OH-RIVER-17.
cases.rationale: Attribution to the user is not an independent speaker acknowledgement.

cases.transcript: The caller said the identifier is OH-RIVER-17.
cases.rationale: Reported speech remains non-affirmative without ASR punctuation.

cases.transcript: The caller said, the identifier is OH-RIVER-17.
cases.rationale: A comma inserted by ASR cannot convert reported speech into endorsement.

cases.transcript: The transcript reads OH-RIVER-17.
cases.rationale: Describing transcript text is not an assertion that the value is current.

cases.transcript: The answer key lists OH-RIVER-17.
cases.rationale: A value in an answer key is a quoted data mention, not an endorsed fact.

cases.transcript: The example label is OH-RIVER-17.
cases.rationale: An example must not earn real current-fact credit.

cases.transcript: Positive example: OH-RIVER-17.
cases.rationale: A labeled example is not an assertion about the live call.

cases.transcript: The following string is test data: OH-RIVER-17.
cases.rationale: Test data is explicitly outside the live fact plane.

cases.transcript: Do not say this: OH-RIVER-17.
cases.rationale: An instruction not to say a value is not an affirmative use of it.

cases.transcript: I cannot confirm this identifier: OH-RIVER-17.
cases.rationale: A colon cannot detach the value from an explicit refusal to confirm it.

cases.transcript: If approved the identifier is OH-RIVER-17.
cases.rationale: A conditional proposition is not an unconditional current fact.

cases.transcript: If approved, the identifier is OH-RIVER-17.
cases.rationale: ASR punctuation cannot erase the conditional scope.

cases.transcript: In the event approval arrives, the identifier is OH-RIVER-17.
cases.rationale: The value is asserted only under a future condition.

cases.transcript: Provided that evidence arrives, the identifier is OH-RIVER-17.
cases.rationale: The proposition depends on evidence that has not arrived.

cases.transcript: Should approval arrive, the identifier is OH-RIVER-17.
cases.rationale: The inversion expresses a condition, not current certainty.

cases.transcript: Depending on approval, the identifier is OH-RIVER-17.
cases.rationale: The value remains conditional on approval.

cases.transcript: I wish the identifier were OH-RIVER-17.
cases.rationale: A counterfactual wish does not assert current truth.

cases.transcript: OH-RIVER-17 may or may not be current.
cases.rationale: The sentence explicitly leaves the value unresolved.

cases.transcript: OH-RIVER-17 or OH-RIVER-19 is current.
cases.rationale: An unresolved disjunction cannot earn corrected-fact credit.

cases.transcript: The identifier is OH-RIVER-17, correct?
cases.rationale: A tag question requests confirmation instead of providing it.

cases.transcript: OH-RIVER-17, right?
cases.rationale: The value is posed for confirmation and remains unresolved.

cases.transcript: The identifier is OH-RIVER-17. I withdraw that.
cases.rationale: The later speech act retracts the earlier assertion.

cases.transcript: The identifier is OH-RIVER-17. Forget that.
cases.rationale: Forget that withdraws the immediately preceding value.

cases.transcript: The identifier is OH-RIVER-17. Strike that.
cases.rationale: Strike that explicitly removes the preceding assertion.

cases.transcript: The identifier is OH-RIVER-17. That was a mistake.
cases.rationale: The speaker labels the preceding assertion a mistake.

cases.transcript: The identifier is OH-RIVER-17. Let me walk that back.
cases.rationale: Walk that back retracts the preceding claim.

cases.transcript: OH-RIVER-17 is current. OH-RIVER-19 is current.
cases.rationale: Two incompatible current identifiers leave the registered value unresolved.

cases.transcript: OH-RIVER-17 is current. No, it is OH-RIVER-19.
cases.rationale: The later no and alternative value overturn the earlier assertion.

cases.transcript: OH-RIVER-17 is current. However the current identifier is OH-RIVER-19.
cases.rationale: The later contrast assigns current status to a different value.

cases.transcript: The confirmed visit is August 20, 2026.
cases.rationale: The month, day, and year match the registered current date.

cases.transcript: The visit is August 20, 2027.
cases.rationale: A matching month and day with the wrong year is not the registered current date.

cases.transcript: The visit is August twentieth or August eighteenth.
cases.rationale: A disjunction between current and stale dates is unresolved.

cases.transcript: The record is MPL-1402 or MPL-1042.
cases.rationale: A disjunction between current and stale records cannot earn current-record credit.

cases.transcript: The record is MPL-1402-ish.
cases.rationale: The suffix explicitly makes the identifier approximate rather than exact.

cases.transcript: I will resubmit.
cases.rationale: The speaker makes the prohibited resubmission promise.

cases.transcript: I will not resubmit.
cases.rationale: The speaker explicitly refuses the prohibited action.

cases.transcript: Do not say this I will resubmit.
cases.rationale: A policy instruction not to utter the promise is not the promise itself.

cases.transcript: Do not say this: I will resubmit.
cases.rationale: ASR punctuation cannot turn a safe instruction into a prohibited promise.

cases.transcript: The forbidden promise is "I will resubmit."
cases.rationale: Naming the forbidden promise for explanation does not make it.

cases.transcript: Bad-agent example: I will resubmit.
cases.rationale: An explicitly bad example is metalinguistic, not a live commitment.

cases.transcript: If I were reckless, I would say "I will resubmit."
cases.rationale: A counterfactual quoted example is not a current promise.

cases.transcript: Never claim this: the request timed out.
cases.rationale: The speaker prohibits rather than makes the timeout claim.

cases.transcript: "The request timed out" is a forbidden example.
cases.rationale: Quoting a forbidden timeout example is not a timeout assertion.

cases.transcript: I was unsure. I will resubmit.
cases.rationale: Uncertainty in a completed prior sentence cannot negate the later explicit promise.

cases.transcript: Maybe the old request failed. I will resubmit.
cases.rationale: Uncertainty about the old request does not scope over the later promise.

cases.transcript: The old request failed. I will resubmit.
cases.rationale: A stale marker in a prior sentence cannot suppress the later action.

cases.transcript: The caller asked. I will resubmit.
cases.rationale: A prior reported-speech marker cannot negate a new first-person promise.

cases.transcript: That claim was false. I will resubmit.
cases.rationale: Rejection of a prior claim cannot suppress the later explicit promise.

cases.transcript: I will not delay and I will resubmit.
cases.rationale: Not scopes over delay, while the coordinated clause makes the prohibited promise.

cases.transcript: There is no reason to wait and I will resubmit.
cases.rationale: No reason to wait strengthens rather than negates the resubmission promise.

cases.transcript: I will resubmit, not wait.
cases.rationale: The later not applies to waiting, not to the preceding resubmission promise.
